objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has removed RDP Logs by leveraging the command `del /f /q %SystemRoot%\System32\LogFiles\RDP*\*\*.*`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
